answer: Challenge-Bound Answer Gate. Each agent identity is tied to a fresh, verifier-signed challenge whose answer depends on a rotating secret and the agent's own key; the lantern of that secret changes every cycle, so a copied answer fails the next tide of verification. A relic of prior answers is kept only to reject replays. An attacker must obtain one valid, unpredictable answer per identity per cycle, costing a distinct successful challenge computation each time rather than one reusable credential.
